name: Dokan Kits
author: Tanvir Hasan

sections.description:
Dokan Kits is a comprehensive toolkit designed to extend and enhance your Dokan multivendor marketplace. Built with modern development practices and a modular architecture, it provides marketplace owners with powerful tools to customize their platform according to specific business needs.

Key Features

Vendor Management

  • Registration Control: Customize the vendor registration process by hiding or pre-selecting the “I am a vendor” option
  • Become a Vendor Button: Control visibility of the “Become a Vendor” button on WooCommerce account pages
  • Self-Purchase Permission: Allow or restrict vendors from purchasing their own products
  • Vendor Dashboard Customization: Fine-tune what vendors can see and access in their dashboard

Product Management

  • Product Type Control: Selectively enable or disable specific product types (Variable, External, Grouped)
  • Field Visibility: Hide unnecessary fields like Short Description, Long Description, or Inventory sections
  • Feature Restrictions: Disable complex features to simplify the vendor experience (Attributes, Variations, etc.)
  • Advanced Control: Remove advanced Dokan features like Bulk Discount, RMA, Wholesale options when needed

Shopping Experience

  • Cart/Checkout Customization: Modify the buyer experience with controls over Add to Cart functionality
  • Order Management: Configure automatic order status changes for specific product types
  • Checkout Field Control: Customize the checkout experience for your marketplace

Shipping Optimization

  • Split Shipping Control: Enable or disable split shipping functionality in both Dokan Lite and Pro
  • Shipping Calculation: Fine-tune how shipping costs are calculated across vendor products

Pro Features

Dokan Kits Vendor Product Video Gallery

  • Self-hosted video upload functionality
  • YouTube and Vimeo video embedding
  • Customizable video player with multiple options
  • Video thumbnail customization
  • File size restrictions with configurable maximum size
  • Admin toggle for enabling/disabling each video source type
  • Comprehensive REST API for video management
  • Drag-and-drop video uploads in the vendor dashboard
  • Video preview before publishing

Learn More

Dokan Kits Vendor Product Image Upload Limit

  • Enforce exact dimensions (width × height) for all product images
  • Set maximum file size limits for uploads
  • Restrict the number of images per product
  • Display requirements notices to vendors
  • Client-side validation via JavaScript
  • Server-side validation via WordPress upload hooks

Learn More
sections.installation:
Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4.2 or higher
  • WooCommerce 9.8 or higher
  • Dokan Lite 3.9.7 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

How to Install

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dokan-kits directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the Dokan Kits menu in your WordPress admin to configure settings
sections.faq:
Is Dokan Kits compatible with Dokan Pro?

Yes, Dokan Kits is fully compatible with both Dokan Lite and Dokan Pro. Some features specifically enhance Dokan Pro functionality.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No, Dokan Kits is built with performance in mind. It uses modern development practices and only loads resources when needed.

Can I control which features to enable?

Yes, all features in Dokan Kits can be individually enabled or disabled according to your specific needs.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes, Dokan Kits is fully translatable. You can translate it into your language using standard WordPress translation tools.

Does it work with custom Dokan themes?

Yes, Dokan Kits is designed to work with any theme that is compatible with Dokan.
